task.title: P6-032: Add a merge-gate step asserting skills tree parity
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 2 — Ship gates). Original id: P6-032. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md, specs/delivery-pipeline.md.

**Add a merge-gate step asserting `diff -rq .claude/skills .agents/skills`.** Verified 2026-07-30: the two trees had drifted **again**, two days after the 2026-07-26 manual resync — `i-have-adhd` existed only under `.claude/`, and `.agents/skills/phase-6-review/SKILL.md` was missing the changes from `80c7395`/`2cd1b6d`. **The trees were resynced on 2026-07-30** (`i-have-adhd` mirrored; `phase-6-review` retired from both), so only the gate step remains — and the second drift in four days is the evidence that a manual resync is not the fix. `validate.yml` still has no parity step. This is the second observed drift, which retires the argument that a manual resync is enough: the failure is invisible because both trees are plausible in isolation, and the 2026-07-26 instance had four of six mirrors prescribing the ~1.44M-token loop the cost recalibration exists to prevent. Cheapest durable fix is the gate step; the alternative is making one tree a symlink of the other, if the agent harnesses tolerate it.
